source_note: An inherited comment was normalized after evaluation; executable syntax is verified identical to the frozen evaluated policy.
changes: Preserve the immediate-hit tie break from markov_defense.py.
Check a heat-free route to an area safe through match end, even when the current local margin looks comfortable.
Commit to an urgent escape through a closing passage until reaching the final safe area.
Invalidate the escape cache immediately when the inherited observer detects a teleport.

validation.reuse_reason: The final patch only responds to inherited return-cache invalidation after a teleport. Source equivalence is checked, every teleport-containing match is rerun, and matches with no teleport are behaviorally identical.

limitations: Per-opponent tradeoffs remain; do not infer universal improvement from the aggregate.
The new balanced sample contains five maps, both spawns, for each specialist. Further independent maps may differ.
Markov draws were checked for preservation but not specifically optimized.
